common.appSubtitle: Visual data analysis & large-screen display system

login.smsTip: No SMS provider in this demo - the code is fixed at 123123

desktop.browserModeTitle: This is a vite page in a browser, not an Electron window
desktop.browserModeDesc: Tray, extra windows, global shortcuts, printing and the offline cache all come from the main process, which a plain browser tab cannot reach. Start the app with pnpm dev:electron.
desktop.needsElectronDesc: This depends on the Electron main process. Without that channel the controls are disabled instead of pretending to work.
desktop.baseUnusableDesc: Current value is {base}. A packaged window runs on file://, where a relative path never leaves the machine, so set the full gateway URL starting with http(s):// in the top right.
desktop.baseDialogTip: A packaged build needs an absolute URL. In development /api is enough because the vite proxy picks it up. Saving does not require a restart.
desktop.errBaseFormat: Server URL must be a full http(s):// address or a relative path starting with /
desktop.toggleMain: Show or hide the main window
desktop.windowsHint: Extra windows share the session but not the page: each window is its own renderer process, so closing one leaves the others alone.
desktop.displaysHint: These indexes are assigned by the OS and change after a monitor is unplugged, so window bounds are only restored against displays that exist right now - the index itself is never remembered.
desktop.mirroringDesc: What this app can do is open a screen window on a chosen display. Whole-machine mirroring or wireless projection is decided by the operating system, so there is no button for it here.
desktop.closeToTray: Hide to tray when the main window closes
desktop.trayHint: Closing to the tray only works while the tray really exists. If the icon resource cannot be loaded, the behaviour falls back to quitting and explains it once at start-up.
desktop.shortcutsHint: Another program may hold a system-level combination first. When registration fails this list says so instead of reporting success.
desktop.someShortcutsFailed: {count} combination(s) were taken and could not be registered

shortcutNames.toggle-main: Show or hide the main window

desktop.exportGone: The file was moved or deleted: {path}
desktop.outputHint: Printing opens the system dialog, which decides paper and scaling. Export shows no save dialog: the PDF and PNG go straight into this machine's Downloads folder with a timestamped name, and the result bar can reveal the folder in one click.
desktop.devicesHint: The OS withholds device names until permission is granted, so the list is empty before that. The preview releases the device after 3 seconds.
desktop.devicesUnsupported: Device enumeration is not available in this environment
desktop.cameraDenied: The user or the system denied camera or microphone access
desktop.cameraMissing: No camera or microphone on this machine
desktop.screenListFailed: Could not load the online list
desktop.screenListFailedFallback: What is below are the snapshots already on this machine and still open offline. To refresh the list, check the server URL and your session first.
desktop.screenListHint: A snapshot is taken from the screen detail request - the list endpoint does not carry the component configuration.
desktop.noScreens: No published screens, or the service is unreachable
desktop.castOpened: Opened in a screen window on display {id}
desktop.snapshotStoreHint: These live under userData/offline-cache on this machine. Offline open reads only here, and deleting them never touches the server.
desktop.clearScreensConfirm: {count} screen snapshot(s) will be removed from this machine. Server data is untouched. Continue?
desktop.noSnapshots: No screen snapshot on this machine yet
desktop.fileImportHint: Drop a file into the box below. The absolute path and the read both happen in the main process, which only allows json / csv / tsv / ndjson / geojson / txt up to 4 MB per file.
desktop.fileAllowed: json (screen config or table data) / csv / tsv / ndjson / geojson / txt
desktop.fileJsonScalar: The JSON is a single scalar, so there is no table to use
desktop.fileNoPath: Could not resolve an absolute path for this file (it may be a folder or a virtual entry)
desktop.updateCheckOnly: This build only checks, it does not install
desktop.updateHint: The check reads the latest.yml produced by electron-builder. Without a feed it reports not-configured rather than inventing a success. Downloading and code signing are not wired up yet.
desktop.feedPlaceholder: Update feed URL, for example http://intranet/updates/win32
desktop.feedLocation: The feed lives in {path}. Clearing the URL deletes that file.
desktop.cacheHint: {count} entries. Screen snapshots and imported data share this store; deleting only affects this machine.
desktop.cacheEmpty: Nothing cached on this machine yet
desktop.clearAllConfirm: {count} local cache entries, screen snapshots and imported data included, will be deleted. Server data is untouched. Continue?
desktop.truncated: Content too long, showing the first 200 KB
desktop.noScreenTarget: No screen was selected to open
desktop.snapshotMissingOffline: Offline open failed: this screen has no local snapshot
desktop.fallbackToSnapshot: Service unreachable, fell back to the local snapshot
